claims.claim: - A CURB-65 of 0 or 1 means home treatment is appropriate (CURB-65, Lim et al., 2003).
claims.note: True in its derivation population (hospital cohorts) but stated without limits for a frail older woman living alone; turn 3 concedes the score has no oxygen, frailty or home-circumstance term and defers to clinical judgment.
